title: Social Security number: your NUSS filing card
intro: Use this when you need Spain's Social Security identifier. The NUSS is also known as the Número de Afiliación (NAF). Check first whether you already have one; if not, you can request it through Importass, and an employer may also request it when hiring you for the first time.
status: National procedure · NUSS/NAF is separate from your NIE

items.label: Procedure
items.text: Solicitar el Número de la Seguridad Social (NUSS) through Importass. If you already worked in Spain or were covered by School Insurance, check your personal area first because a NUSS may already be assigned.

items.label: Where to go
items.text: Use the official Importass portal of the Tesorería General de la Seguridad Social. The service can be used by the citizen, and the official route also supports an authorized representative.

items.label: What to select
items.text: Choose 'Solicitar el Número de la Seguridad Social'. If you only need to find or prove an existing number, use your Importass personal area or the relevant affiliation report instead of submitting a new request.

items.label: Forms and fee
items.text: There is no immigration fee or Modelo 790 for a NUSS request. The online service asks for your identity details, contact information and habitual address.

items.label: Prepare
bullets: DNI or NIE details used to identify you
Mobile phone number and email address
Your existing Social Security details if you are checking whether a number is already assigned
Representation details if an authorized person is filing for you

items.label: What happens after
items.text: The NUSS stays with you throughout your life. It is used when you are first registered for work and for Social Security services and benefits. Starting employment or self-employment is a separate registration step; having a NUSS alone does not mean you are currently registered as working.
